title: Unit – 4 : Session – 7 : SLO – 2  |  Binary Search Trees — Deletion Operation
sections: Deletion in BST has THREE cases.
Case 1: Node to be deleted is a LEAF.
In case 3, find the INORDER SUCCESSOR (or inorder predecessor).
In case 3, replace the node with its INORDER SUCCESSOR'S value.
In case 3, finally DELETE the inorder successor node.
In case 2, if left child is missing, replace with RIGHT child.
In case 2, if right child is missing, replace with LEFT child.
A leaf node can be directly REMOVED (deleted).
II. Algorithm to Delete a Node from a BST
ELSE IF TREE -> LEFT AND TREE -> RIGHT
IF TREE -> LEFT = NULL AND TREE -> RIGHT = NULL
